Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

Crispy Baked Chicken Thighs Get ready for the ultimate easy dinner. These bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs are seasoned to perfection and baked until the skin is beautifully shattered-crisp while the meat stays incredibly juicy and tender. Ingredients Chicken: 6 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs Oil: 1.5 tbsp olive oil (or melted butter) The Seasoning Blend: 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp dried oregano or thyme 1 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp cracked black pepper 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, for a tiny kick) Instructions Prep: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet or baking dish with aluminum foil for easy cleanup. Dry the Skin: Pat the chicken thighs completely dry with paper towels. This is the most important step for achieving maximum skin crispiness! Season: In a small bowl, mix all the spices together. Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken thighs, then rub the spice mixture generously all over them, making sure to get underneath the skin as well. Arrange: Place the chicken thighs on the prepared baking sheet, skin-side up, leaving a little space between each piece so they roast instead of steam. Bake: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the skin is deeply browned and crispy, and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) at the thickest part. Rest: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving to lock in all those delicious juices. Tip: If you want an extra-shattery, charred crust, pop them under the oven broiler for the last 2–3 minutes of cooking. Just keep a close eye on them so they don't burn! #BakedChicken #ChickenThighs #EasyDinner #CrispyChicken #SheetPanDinner

Sizzlin’ Chicken Fajitas 🔥 recipe from @Inaki Godoy Chaos Kitchen cookbook using @TABASCO BRAND sauce Chicken​​ 1½ pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into ½-inch strips ​​ 2 tablespoons TABASCO® Original Red Sauce ​​ 3 tablespoons olive oil, divided ​​ ½ teaspoon kosher salt ​​ ½ teaspoon ground black pepper ​​ ½ teaspoon garlic powder ​​ ½ teaspoon white onion powder ​​ Vegetables​​ 1 large onion, thinly sliced ​​ 2 colorful bell peppers, cut into strips​​ For Serving​​ Flour tortillas ​​ Optional Toppings​​ Shredded cheese ​​ Mexican crema or sour cream ​​ Pico de gallo or your favorite salsa ​​ Guacamole​ Instructions​​ In a large bowl or resealable plastic bag, combine 2 tablespoons TABASCO® Original Red Sauce, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Add the chicken and toss to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 4 hours.​​ Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.  Add the onion and bell peppers and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp and lightly caramelized, about 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer the vegetables to a plate and keep warm. ​​ Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess drip off, and discard the remaining marinade.  Add the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil to the same skillet. Add the chicken to the skillet in a single layer and cook, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 10 to 15 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.​​ Return the cooked vegetables to the skillet and toss with the chicken until heated through, about 1 to 2 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt, if desired.​​ Serve the chicken and vegetables in warm flour tortillas. Juicy Pan-Seared Chicken Breast in Creamy Garlic Parmesan Sauce Ingredients 1. Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts – 4 medium (about 1.5–2 lb) 2. Olive Oil – 2 tbsp 3. Unsalted Butter – 3 tbsp 4. Garlic – 5 cloves, minced 5. All-Purpose Flour – 2 tbsp 6. Chicken Broth – 1 cup 7. Heavy Cream – 1 cup 8. Grated Parmesan Cheese – ¾ cup 9. Mozzarella Cheese – ½ cup, shredded 10. Italian Seasoning – 1 tsp 11. Paprika – 1 tsp 12. Garlic Powder – 1 tsp 13. Onion Powder – ½ tsp 14. Salt – 1 tsp, or to taste 15. Black Pepper – ½ tsp 16. Red Pepper Flakes – ¼ tsp 17. Lemon Juice – 1 tbsp 18. Fresh Parsley – 3 tbsp, finely chopped 19. Fresh Thyme – 1 tsp, chopped Recipe 1. Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels. If they are very thick, slice them horizontally into thinner cutlets or gently pound them to an even thickness for consistent cooking. 2. In a small bowl, combine the salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and Italian seasoning. Season both sides of each chicken breast evenly with this mixture. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breasts in a single layer without overcrowding the pan, working in batches if necessary. 4. Sear the chicken for 5–7 minutes on the first side until deeply golden brown. Flip and cook for another 4–6 minutes, depending on thickness, until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C). 5. Transfer the cooked chicken to a plate and cover loosely with foil to keep it warm. Leave the flavorful browned bits in the skillet because they will add richness to the sauce. 6. Reduce the heat to medium and add the butter to the same skillet. Once melted, add the minced garlic and red pepper flakes, stirring for about 30–45 seconds until fragrant. 7. Sprinkle the flour into the garlic butter and whisk continuously for 1 minute. This creates a light roux that will thicken the sauce and give it a smooth consistency. 8. Gradually pour in the chicken broth while whisking to dissolve the browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Simmer for 2 minutes until the liquid begins to thicken slightly. 9. Slowly stir in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Avoid boiling vigorously, as excessive heat can affect the creamy texture of the sauce. 10. Add the Parmesan cheese and mozzarella cheese a handful at a time, stirring until both cheeses melt completely. Continue simmering gently for 2–3 minutes until the sauce becomes rich, creamy, and velvety. 11. Stir in the lemon juice, chopped parsley, and fresh thyme. Taste the sauce and adjust the salt and black pepper as needed to balance the creamy, cheesy flavor. 12. Return the chicken breasts and any accumulated juices to the skillet. Spoon the garlic Parmesan sauce over each piece and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes, allowing the flavors to blend without overcooking the chicken. 13. Arrange the chicken on a serving plate and pour the remaining creamy sauce around and over the pieces. Garnish with extra parsley and Parmesan, then serve hot with mashed potatoes, pasta, steamed vegetables, or crusty bread. Follow for more easy and delicious homemade recipes!
